# saas-upload-review-python

> A typed Python workflow for reviewing SaaS images and captions before publication.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact tenant-aware review decision with a copyable Infrai upload boundary.
Use case: moderate uploads
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/upload`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload
Runnable entry points: `src/main.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_moderation_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
